purpose: Every governing modality-level experiment: dataset, biological n, controls, primary effect, heterogeneity, classification, replication, and the final architecture decision it maps to.
cross_row_comparability_prohibition: PROHIBITED: raw metric magnitudes across different targets/datasets/model families are not comparable and must never be ranked against each other (results/target_evidence_matrix.json).

rows.primary_effect: HISTORICAL_CAPACITY_CONFOUNDED: original A->B ~1.879 bpm (~20.6% relative, sometimes miscited as ~23%) used Model A (8,065 params) vs Model B (28,865/29,089 params) - NOT capacity-matched. Capacity control (docs/PPG_DALIA_CAPACITY_CONTROL_PREDECLARATION.md) found ~68% of this gap is recovered by capacity/architecture alone (A_cap). The GOVERNING capacity-controlled result is: A_cap->B ~0.605 bpm, C->B ~0.776 bpm, both 5/5 seeds (results/ppg_dalia_capacity_control.json). Per docs/FURKAN_PAPER_HANDOFF_CANONICAL_DAY9.md: do NOT write 20.6%/23% pure IMU, 1.88 bpm clean IMU, or a 59/41 causal split.
rows.heterogeneity_or_sensitivity: inherited context only - not re-verified this branch
rows.replication_state: ORIGINAL_FINDING (this is the finding GalaxyPPG attempted to replicate)
rows.burden_relevance: wrist IMU already co-located with PPG in a wristband module - near-zero marginal burden
rows.safe_claim: Under a capacity-controlled comparison, aligned wrist IMU added a smaller but real HR-estimation benefit (A_cap->B ~0.605 bpm, C->B ~0.776 bpm, 5/5 seeds) beyond a capacity-matched PPG-only baseline on PPG-DaLiA. The original ~20.6%/23% figure is historical and capacity-confounded - never cite it as a clean IMU effect.
rows.architecture_decision_note: Foundational MINIMAL_CORE sensor; governs wrist IMU inclusion.

rows.primary_effect: A=0.7358, B=0.7876, C=0.7280 (mean). A-B=-0.0518, C-B=-0.0596 - B is WORSE on aggregate mean, but 7/10 subjects individually favor B - single-subject-dominated (subject 2, A-B=-0.71) - see results/qde_v2_leg_bioz_stage2.json

rows.biological_n_subjects: 24 total, 18 real reference-ECG-quality-eligible (6 excluded for a real corrupted-reference-ECG data-integrity defect)
rows.primary_effect: STAGE 3 UPDATE (full CV complete): A real BLOCKER was found (6/24 subjects had corrupted reference ECG, near-zero detectable R-peaks) via hostile review of a full 6-fold CV. Fixed (real R-peak-rate eligibility gate added), corrected eligibility=18/24. Full corrected 6-fold CV completed (5 newly-trained folds + 1 independently re-verified reused fold): participant-level A_cap->B=+0.834 bpm (12/18 favor B), C->B=+0.916 bpm (13/18 favor B); window-weighted (33,813 pooled test windows) A_cap->B=+0.845 bpm, C->B=+0.920 bpm. No sign reversal under either aggregation or leave-one-out exclusion of the most extreme subject. Both the pre-fix single-fold diagnostic and the pre-fix full 6-fold CV remain marked INVALIDATED_BY_REFERENCE_SIGNAL_QUALITY_DEFECT. See results/galaxyppg_corrected_full_cv_result.json and docs/GALAXYPPG_STAGE3_CORRECTED_RESULTS.md.
rows.heterogeneity_or_sensitivity: Real subject heterogeneity disclosed: 6/18 subjects favor A_cap over B, 5/18 favor C over B. No sign reversal at the aggregate level under window-weighted vs participant-level aggregation or under leave-one-out exclusion of the single most extreme subject (P16).
rows.replication_state: EXTERNAL_REPLICATION_SUPPORTIVE (full corrected 6-fold CV, n=18 biological participants)
rows.burden_relevance: same as PPG-DaLiA row - wrist IMU near-zero marginal burden
rows.safe_claim: Aligned wrist IMU added a real but moderate and heterogeneous HR-estimation benefit under a capacity-near-matched comparison on GalaxyPPG (full corrected 6-fold CV, n=18 biological participants, A_cap->B +0.834 bpm, C->B +0.916 bpm, majority of subjects favor B, no aggregate sign reversal) - qualitatively consistent with PPG-DaLiA's capacity-controlled finding, though smaller and less uniform than the earlier bounded single-fold diagnostic suggested.
rows.architecture_decision_note: External corroboration for wrist IMU inclusion (corrected cohort).

rows.primary_effect: STAGE 3 UPDATE (protocol-compliant rerun, HIGH-03 remediation): REAL TRAINING COMPLETE under the frozen 0-60mmHg scope. Real eligibility: 12/16 subjects have valid pleth (4 excluded, real data-quality finding). 200/607 windows excluded for being outside the frozen 0-60mmHg scope (407 in-scope windows used). LOSO (n=12): A=20.973, B=21.425, C=20.132 (MAE mmHg). A-B=-0.452 (3/12 favor B, SIGN-REVERSES if subject 9 excluded). C-B=-1.293 (5/12 favor B over C; B worse than its own different-stage-enforced deranged control, but shrinks substantially without subject 9). COMPLETE_MIXED (substantial subject heterogeneity, not a uniform negative). Real per-subject heterogeneity: subjects 4 and 9 are extreme opposite-direction outliers on A-B. The prior 607-window execution (A=27.62, B=29.86, C=29.83, A-B=-2.24, subjects 4/7 framing, COMPLETE_NEGATIVE) included 200 out-of-scope windows and a C-control with same-stage leakage - HISTORICAL_SUPERSEDED_OUT_OF_PROTOCOL, never cite its numbers as current. See results/lbnp_thoracic_eis_stage3_v2_protocol_compliant.json and docs/LBNP_STAGE3_HIGH03_REMEDIATION.md.
rows.heterogeneity_or_sensitivity: A-B sign-reverses under leave-one-out exclusion of subject 9 (an extreme outlier); C-B remains negative under leave-one-out but shrinks substantially without subject 9 - both key comparisons are partly driven by one influential subject, not a stable cohort-wide effect. Subjects 4 and 9 are the extreme opposite-direction outliers on A-B (not subjects 4/7, which was the prior out-of-protocol run's framing under a different, larger window set).
rows.burden_relevance: thoracic EIS electrodes are a real, distinct contact-region/module burden from ECG/pleth
rows.safe_claim: Corrected LBNP shows no stable aggregate incremental thoracic EIS benefit over ECG+pleth under the frozen terrestrial 0-60 mmHg protocol, with substantial subject heterogeneity - a real but heterogeneous (COMPLETE_MIXED), not uniformly negative, result.

rows.biological_n_subjects: 3 (sub-032, sub-033, sub-034 - neutral-rule first-3-eligible selection, all byte-verified against real git-annex hashes) - NOT the full 65
rows.primary_effect: BOUNDED DIAGNOSTIC (n=3: sub-032/033/034), LOSO macro-F1: A=0.2263 (sd 0.0091), B=0.2765 (sd 0.0522), C=0.2167 (sd 0.0000, indistinguishable from always-predict-majority-class ~0.2167). B numerically above A/C but driven by 2 of 3 subjects (sub-034's B result itself collapses to majority-class level). See results/ds003838_eeg_minimalism_stage3_bounded_diagnostic.json and docs/DS003838_STAGE3_BOUNDED_DIAGNOSTIC.md - NOT the full n=65 cohort.
rows.heterogeneity_or_sensitivity: Not meaningful at n=3 - one of three subjects (sub-034) drives B toward chance level, illustrating exactly why this diagnostic cannot support a conclusion
rows.negative_finding: UNKNOWN at full-cohort scale - diagnostic-only; the deranged control (C) behaving exactly at chance level is a correctly-functioning negative control, not evidence about A vs B
rows.burden_relevance: sparse 4ch (AF7/AF8/TP9/TP10) matches a real shipping wearable (Muse) - if it retains information, near-zero marginal burden vs full montage; if not, argues for a denser real montage
rows.safe_claim: Real-file access to ds003838 is confirmed working end-to-end (byte-verified download, real BIDS label parsing, real epoching). The sparse-vs-full information question itself remains UNRESOLVED pending a future full-cohort run.
rows.architecture_decision_note: Bounded diagnostic feeding sparse-EEG Gate E revision trigger; sparse channel count retained conditionally.

rows.biological_n_subjects: 7 recordings (5 train/1 val/1 test) - bounded by a genuine external PhysioNet TLS certificate expiry mid-download, NOT the frozen full-151 cohort
rows.primary_effect: A=0.4562, B=0.4249, C=0.4169 (mean, 5 seeds). B-A=-0.0313 (2/5 seeds favor B), B-C=+0.0080 (2/5 seeds favor B) - negative-leaning at this bounded n=7/1-test-recording scale. See docs/HMC_BOUNDED_N7_RESULTS.md. | Stage 3 update: PhysioNet certificate confirmed renewed (real access restored). HMC current state (results/hmc_current_download_inventory.json): 59 edf files present, 58 complete recording pairs, 52 SHA256-verified, 1 partial (SN060). Full-cohort training FULL_COHORT_PENDING - n=7 bounded diagnostic remains the only trained result.
rows.heterogeneity_or_sensitivity: Test metric driven entirely by ONE test recording - seed variance reflects within-recording noise, not between-subject variance
rows.replication_state: BOUNDED_DIAGNOSTIC (full-cohort training not yet attempted - a compute/time-budget limit across multiple sprints, not an access blocker; PhysioNet certificate is confirmed renewed and access is real and working)
rows.safe_claim: At this bounded diagnostic scale, the Sleep-EDF EOG benefit did not reproduce on HMC - reported honestly per the frozen negative_result_policy, not generalized beyond n=7.
rows.architecture_decision_note: Bounded diagnostic feeding EOG's Gate E revision trigger; not itself an inclusion/exclusion test.
